Scope and remaining work Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.
